svg.title: India outline filled with "India" in twelve Indian scripts
svg.desc:
Editable asset. Layers, bottom to top: fill - flat base colour; recolour or delete it terrain - EMPTY and already clipped to the coastline; draw physical features in here and they are trimmed to India automatically words - the twelve words as outlines; set fill on the group to recolour them all at once outline - the coastline stroke
India is 1000 units wide (1 unit = 0.1mm at the stated page size). The companion magnifier asset uses the same scale, so it can be placed on this map at 1:1.
Scripts, in the order they repeat: hindi=इंडिया bengali=ইন্ডিয়া telugu=ఇండియా tamil=இந்தியா gujarati=ઇન્ડિયા urdu=انڈیا kannada=ಇಂಡಿಯಾ odia=ଇଣ୍ଡିଆ malayalam=ഇന്ത്യ punjabi=ਇੰਡੀਆ santali=ᱤᱱᱰᱤᱭᱟ meitei=ꯏꯟꯗꯤꯌꯥ
